name: OWASP WSTG
description: A pragmatic pass over the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide categories.

items.guidance: Fingerprint the server, enumerate content and entry points, review metafiles and comments.
Test TLS config, HTTP methods, admin interfaces, and default/backup files.
Review roles, registration, and account provisioning/de-provisioning.
Credential transport, default/weak credentials, lockout, and remember-me handling.
Directory traversal, privilege escalation, and IDOR.
Cookie flags, session fixation, CSRF, and logout/timeout handling.
XSS, SQL/NoSQL/OS/LDAP injection, SSRF, and host-header injection.
Verbose errors and stack traces that disclose internals.
Weak transport crypto, padding-oracle, and sensitive data in transit.
Workflow bypasses, request tampering, and function-abuse cases.
DOM XSS, client-side redirects, postMessage, CORS, and clickjacking.
GraphQL/REST authorization, mass assignment, and rate limiting.
